links.comparator_used: Local model trained on data from two cardiac centres, tested on the other 20 Ontario centres
links.outcome: Discrimination (AUROC), sensitivity and specificity for predicting obstructive CAD
links.effect: Local two-centre model on geographical validation: AUROC 0.714, sensitivity 0.73, specificity 0.57; model updated on province-wide data (N = 319,012): AUROC 0.794, sensitivity 0.708, specificity 0.699
links.quote: However, following updating, performance recovered (AUROC = 0.794 [95% CI: 0.794, 0.795], Sensitivity = 0.708, Specificity = 0.699).

design_hint: local validation and model updating (recalibration) before deployment
